string.name: desc
string.value: Pet will automatically consume potions by setting the MP alert in system option. \n#c Place the pouch in Pet Ability section at Pet Equip window in Equip window as well as the potion for Pet to consume in Pet MP section#

string.name: desc
string.value: With these boots, your pet will move to mesos/items dropped by monsters to collect them. Applies only to your monster spoils if not equiped with Magic Scales. Applies only with combination of which items you are equiped with. (Meso Magnet, Item Pouch)

string.name: desc
string.value: With this Binocular AND Wing Boots, your pet will move to mesos/items dropped by monsters to collect them in a #cwider range than solely equipping Wing Boots.#

string.name: desc
string.value: With these scales, your pet will become knowledgable of ownership expiration of dropped mesos/items from monsters and will also pick them up. Applies only with combination of which items you are equiped with. (Meso Magnet, Item Pouch)

string.name: desc
string.value: This allows the pet to be selective in picking up dropped items by avoiding selected items. Once the owner has learned the Trainer's Command, the Lead Pet needs to have the skill in order for it to be activated.\n#cAvailable to a pet that can pick up mesos and items.#

string.name: desc
string.value: This gem gives your pet the ability to automatically cast buff skills onto its owner. Place your desired skill in the open slot next to the Auto Buff Gem in the pet's Equipment Inventory. You no longer have to worry about casting your favorite buff, your pet will do it for you!

string.name: desc
string.value: Pet will automatically consume an All Cure Potion when the character is at an abnormal state. Drag and drop the pouch and the All Cure Potion stack to designated slot in the pet equip window.

string.name: desc
string.value: Train your pet to make it smart! When you have the Meso Magnet and/or the Item pouch equipped, your pets ability to navigate multi-leveled maps is greatly increased. It will also learn to use the Auto Feed Pet feature.

string.name: desc
string.value: By equipping this ring, your pet will get its own name tag. Only works with #cPanda, Dino Boy, Dino Girl, Monkey, Tiger, Rudolph, Robot, Mini Yeti, Penguin, Jr.Balrog, Sun Wu Kong, Dragon, Jr. Reaper, Porcupine, Snowman, Kino, Skunk, Robo, Toucan, White Duck, Pink Bean, Mir, Ruby, Corgi Pup, Persian Cat, Cake, Pie.#
